author: Flo
html: Let me put it this way… It WOULD have been a nice article if the author wasn’t so obviously biased. This way, this article basically reads like a click-bait ad and it’s hard to take it seriously. It would be interesting to see comparisons from independent sources (with some experience with Kafka), though.

author: Peter Lawrey
html:
It should be read as a biased article as the author is much more familiar with one product than another.

However, in terms of the 99%ile latencies reported for Kafka, this article reports a latency faster than any I could find published in most places elsewhere. One article was 10% faster.
If you are aware of any benchmark showing Kafka is significantly faster than 2.6 ms on the 99% under load, I would appreciate you sharing them.
For context, Chronicle Queue is getting latencies less than 0.01 ms on the 99%ile.

This shows a system with a 99%ile latency of 2.33 ms end to end on an AWS R5.2xlarge
https://armkeil.blob.core.windows.net/developer/Files/pdf/white-paper/benchmarking-apache-kafka.pdf

From Linkedin, the 99%ile is 3 ms in this test
https://engineering.linkedin.com/kafka/benchmarking-apache-kafka-2-million-writes-second-three-cheap-machines

Published by Confluent, the 99%ile latency is around 5 ms under load
https://developer.confluent.io/learn/kafka-performance/
https://www.confluent.io/en-gb/blog/kafka-fastest-messaging-system/

A more complex case, however the *typical* latency is around 7 ms
https://www.instaclustr.com/blog/the-power-of-kafka-partitions-how-to-get-the-most-out-of-your-kafka-cluster/

In these scenarios, the lowest 99%ile latency is 7 ms
https://www.datastax.com/blog/2019/08/performance-comparison-between-apache-pulsar-and-kafka-latency

Published by Pulsar to show it is better than Kafka for this use case, the latency of Pulsar is 5 ms on the 99%ile
https://streamnative.io/blog/tech/2020-11-09-benchmark-pulsar-kafka-performance/

This Benchmark shows Redpanda as faster (it’s their product) yet the 99%ile latency is around 10 ms for this use case
https://redpanda.com/blog/redpanda-vs-kafka-performance-benchmark

In these tests, the lowest 99%ile latency reported was 59 ms
https://www.davidxia.com/2021/08/benchmarking-kafka-and-google-cloud-pub-slash-sub-latencies/
